instruction: Configure Thunderbird to poll for new messages every 15 minutes instead of the default, minimizing bandwidth consumption.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Thunderbird to check for new mail every 15 minutes. The evaluator verifies that mail.server.server1.check_new_mail is true (enabled) and mail.server.server1.check_time is set to 15. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same application, similar configuration complexity with 2 related settings

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts Thunderbird preferences state by fetching the prefs.js file from VM
Complete coverage: verifies BOTH required settings (check_new_mail=true AND check_time=15)
Metric logic correctly parses prefs.js format using regex pattern matching and checks expected values
Expected values are semantically correct for the task (enable auto-check + 15 minute interval)
Proper postconfig: closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Edge case handling: metric handles None result and missing preferences gracefully
Metric parameter handling is correct: directly accesses rule.get('expect') as per framework spec for type='rule'
Static type warning is a false positive: get_vm_file returns str (not list) when multi=False, and metric handles None case

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
